name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler_51' = dispatch idx 0x51 in the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91; verified by sole xref From 0x00051cd5 [DATA] where (0x51CD5 - 0x51B91)/4 = 0x51, so '_51' is a genuine domain dispatch-slot ID (not an address residue; the function lives at 0x35F6F). '__unref' is accurate (0 direct callers; only reachable via the dispatch table, and no chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot). 'dyn_turn_event' matches the body (advances stage counter + re-arms a turn-event hook) and is the same descriptor used by sibling handlers 3e/41/4f. No address residue.
purpose: Self-looping turn-event pump (dispatch idx 0x51): advance the tile-event stage counter and queue another turn-event fire one player turn ahead.
logic_summary: Two stores after the Watcom __CHK stack-probe prologue: (1) INC the 8-bit stage counter at tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] (INC byte ptr [EAX+0x10]); (2) read battle_turn_counter as a single byte, INC it in 8-bit (MOV DL,[turn_counter] / INC DL), and store the truncated result into tile_event_data_table[+3] (hook entry 0's turn byte), arming the next fire one player turn ahead. No consume-flag gate (unlike gated schedulers handler_3e/41), so each call advances the stage and re-arms the same hook slot. event_arg is unread.
